description: Figure 1 is a line plot illustrating the similarity of Hidden State Activations (HSAs) for four different language pairs across the layers of the Qwen1.5-1.8B model. The horizontal x-axis, labeled "Layer," is a linear scale ranging from 0 to 22, with major tick marks at intervals of 2. The vertical y-axis, labeled "Similarity," is also a linear scale, ranging from 0.00 to 0.45, with major tick marks at intervals of 0.05. The plot contains four distinct lines, each representing a language pair as indicated in the legend: "en&en" (red solid line), "en&es" (blue solid line), "en&el" (green solid line), and "en&bn" (magenta solid line). All four lines exhibit a similar trend: they start at a low similarity (around 0.05) for layers 0-4, rise to a peak around layer 6 (with "en&en" reaching approximately 0.27), dip to a local minimum around layer 10, and then show a sharp, steep increase in similarity from layer 20 onwards, culminating in values above 0.30 for all pairs by layer 22. The red line ("en&en") consistently remains at or near the top, indicating the highest similarity across all layers, while the other three lines track closely together for most of the plot.
